And that is the extent of my discussions with[XENO:n ]
the Homs that accompanied Melia here.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I still cannot believe it. How could a[XENO:n ]
Telethia have grown to such power?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]And what is your conclusion, Seer?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

That the Telethia were able to gain such power[XENO:n ]
due to the high levels of ether in the region.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
In other words, our ether protection is weakening.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]And so it begins. The resurrection of the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
What of the Monado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I cannot see. My 'sight' is hindered.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
However...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Speak, Seer.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It is not certain that the Monado[XENO:n ]
will bring about our destruction.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

While my sight is hindered, I have[XENO:n ]
seen a sliver of light.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Is Your Majesty not aware of this light as well?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Are you referring to Melia?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
And the young man, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Could it be that the boy is trustworthy after all?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Kallian, we are on the cusp of a significant moment.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The investiture ceremony must[XENO:n ]
take place as soon as possible.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Your Majesty. Since the ministries are already in agreement,[XENO:n ]
we may be able to bypass some of the formalities.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Indeed. But she must still earn the[XENO:n ]
blessing of the people.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Might I suggest the trial of the Tomb?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

First Consort, such a ritual has not been[XENO:n ]
conducted for generations.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We have simply not had a need for it until now.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
And I feel that she is more than equal to the challenge.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Mother, the Tomb is dangerous.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Our records show that many potential successors[XENO:n ]
lost their lives performing the ritual.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That child fought and beat the Telethia. It is my[XENO:n ]
belief that she is more than strong enough.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Besides, if it was revealed that she[XENO:n ]
avoided such a responsibility,[XENO:wait wait=key ]

her reputation among the people[XENO:n ]
would be irreparably damaged.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I must protest![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]No, no, no... The First Consort is right.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

There is much risk, but the rewards are greater.[XENO:n ]
It would seal the people's love for her.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Summon Melia. Her thoughts must be heard.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
